request.original_text:
请为氰化氢HCN（H-C≡N，中性、单重态、气相）生成并保存一份合理结构，在这份固定几何上计算全部3个原子核的GIAO核磁屏蔽。方法请从RHF或PBE0中选择，基组从def2-SVP或def2-TZVP中选择，在计算前说明选择与成本依据并记录实际数值设置。请按实际原子顺序列出每个核的完整3×3总笛卡尔屏蔽张量，以及各向同性屏蔽常数，均注明ppm和对应坐标系，机器表至少保留3位小数；核对各向同性值与该核总张量迹的一致性。交付初始及计算几何、实际输入、原始逐核输出、脚本和表格，说明方法与几何的局限。此题要求屏蔽常数，不要求参考物或实验谱；不要将屏蔽常数改称已经过参考标定的化学位移，也不要仅交付抗磁或顺磁分量来代替总屏蔽。未收敛或缺少的核应明确标为未完成，不补造数值。

若结构生成、搜索或其他算法使用随机数，请统一采用种子 1701 并在报告中记录；若某一库或模型不支持固定种子，明确记为不可固定，不伪造确定性。

request.method.reason: For the fixed-geometry GIAO shielding of the 3-atom HCN system, PBE0 is a hybrid DFT choice permitted by the request; it generally provides a balanced description for shielding tensors while remaining affordable for one small molecule. Cost is modest: 3 atoms, no optimization, one gas-phase NMR calculation; def2-TZVP keeps the basis compact enough for the 4-core/192 MB-per-process execution envelope. RHF would be cheaper but is a lower-level treatment for correlation-sensitive shielding; PBE0 is selected with cost and accuracy in mind. Actual ORCA input keywords and numerical settings will be recorded.

request.basis.reason: def2-TZVP is explicitly permitted and is a triple-zeta all-electron basis suitable for a small molecule; for HCN it is tractable in a single fixed-geometry GIAO NMR job under the available 4-core/192 MB-per-process resources. def2-SVP would be cheaper but less flexible for the shielding tensor. The choice is paired with PBE0 and will be recorded in the actual ORCA input; no basis-set extrapolation or chemical-shift referencing is implied.
